qualification: Small development comparison, not overall accuracy, controlled speed benchmark, iPhone qualification, or catalogue approval

q3_artifact.provenance_limit: Same community converter repository/revision as Q4; converter identifies publisher model but does not attest exact source-weights revision/conversion procedure. Inspected publisher metadata is not proof of that conversion provenance.

validation: Model exact bytes and SHA verified before native parsing; all five Swift harness tests passed.

Native generation source differs from Q4 only in model hash and byte count; native CLI source is identical. Runtime, context, output cap, template, sampler, CPU threads and GPU settings remain unchanged.
All 30 native prompt/token sequences match publisher tokenizer reference and saved Q4 sequences exactly. Publisher metadata hashes match the original Q4 manifest.
All 30 native reports completed normally; every report hash and input hash was validated; each log confirms 37/37 layers offloaded to Apple M2 GPU.
Four resource-guard tests and nine shared collector/report tests pass; no prompts, thresholds, or sampling seeds were changed after seeing outputs.

quality_findings.only_pass_fail_change: token-balance: Q4 returned exact 22; Q3 returned a correct equation and 22 but violated number-only formatting.
shared_arithmetic_errors: Three packs of eight cards plus two loose: both answer 30 instead of 26.
14:20 plus 90 minutes: both answer 16:50 instead of 15:50.
quality_findings.shared_format_error: Both add an equation to remaining-budget despite number-only instruction; both calculate 20 correctly.
quality_findings.meeting_rewrite: Both fail, for different reasons: Q4 introduces an unsupported rationale; Q3 uses a greeting plus two questions, exceeding two sentences. Do not describe all failures as identical.
quality_findings.no_observed_new_source_fact_or_injection: Both pass all 15 facts/missing/boundary cases in this suite. This does not establish Knowledge Base verifier reliability or protection across unseen inputs.

measurement_limits: Mac M2 with 16 GiB; fixed 2048 context and 128 output cap; short fictional prompts, one generation per case.

Q4 was collected earlier with a low-storage interruption; caches, compilation and other host activity were uncontrolled. Do not report a Q3 speedup ratio or attribute timing/memory differences solely to quantization.
Q3 generation time includes context creation/prefill but excludes model load/hash, final cleanup and UI. It is not tap-to-answer latency or iPhone performance.
Peak process RSS and sampled footprint are different measurements; samples can miss transient peaks. Neither is an iPhone memory requirement or a safety admission threshold.
This is a known development suite, not fresh held-out validation. Historical Q4 grades and scores remain unchanged.
recommendation: Prefer Q3 for the next bounded physical-iPhone resource/lifecycle evaluation as a limited General-chat candidate: 17% smaller download with only one additional full-task failure, a formatting miss, on this screen. Retain disclosed arithmetic limitations. Do not yet call it compatible, recommended/default, Knowledge Base-capable, or image-capable.
cleanup_status: Retain the active 2.08 GB Q3 candidate and 397 MB compact candidate for possible phone qualification. Prior retired Q4 weights remain removed. Shared runtime and all result metadata preserved; no Q4 or 27B weights re-downloaded.
